biggest_catch: Your $75 credit doesn't post until 60 days after your friend signs up — and if you cancel your Midco account before then, the credit is forfeited.
catches: Referrer's $75 credit posts to their account only after 60 days
Credit has no cash value and will not be refunded; if the referring customer cancels, all remaining referral credits are forfeited
Friend must be a new residential customer adding internet, TV and/or phone in a Midco-serviceable area; business services don't qualify
To receive the credit you must keep your account payment status current
Limit of seven referral code uses ($525 in account credits) per calendar year
